text: oh lets move that around, i like  your idea i hate that it causes the whole ui to shift. lay it inside of the container space for the actual mesh rather than above the toolbar. like right in here [Image #2]
resolution: Floated the paint bar inside the mesh viewport instead of pushing the whole UI down. It was an in-flow strip under the menu bar, so entering paint mode shifted the entire editor; now it's a rounded floating pill rendered as a LATE overlay (this layout paints in tree order, so it must be a late root child to sit over the 3D view), absolutely positioned just inside the viewport (left 410 = past the fixed rail 48 + content panel 350, top 78 = below the model title strip). Its popovers drop from it (repositioned to match). Nothing in the layout shifts anymore. Cart-only, hot-reloads; transforms clean. Sha 6e71c2bf0. The left/top anchor is currently constant (relies on the fixed rail+panel widths) — if the content panel ever collapses or the exact y is off, it's a one-line nudge or a follow-up to anchor it relative to the viewport container itself.
